jsonLd.name: Eleven Web Development Agency in Moscow
jsonLd.description: We are web development agency crafting custom, SEO-optimized websites. From responsive design to e-commerce builds—elevate your brand. Get a free quote today!

webDesign.name: Custom Web Design Services
webDesign.description: Tailored UI/UX designs that are visually stunning and user-centric, ensuring seamless navigation and brand alignment.

webDevelopment.name: Full-Stack Web Development
webDevelopment.description: Robust backend and frontend development using modern stacks like React, Next.js, Node.js, Java, and SpringBoot for scalable, secure websites.

seoOptimization.name: SEO and Digital Marketing
seoOptimization.description: Comprehensive SEO strategies, including on-page optimization, content audits, and link-building to boost organic traffic and rankings.

websiteMaintainace.name: Ongoing Website Maintenance and Support
websiteMaintainace.description: Proactive maintenance, security updates, performance monitoring, and 24/7 support to keep your site running smoothly.

HeroBlock.title: a web studio from Moscow building products that bring in clients
HeroBlock.subTitle1: Design and development from start to finish: websites, online stores, landing pages, mobile apps and Telegram mini apps — with AI integration.
HeroBlock.subTitle2: We pick the technology to fit the project, not the other way round — so your site is fast, easy to use and reliable.

whyUsItems.item1: Your site loads fast and works just as well on a phone, tablet or laptop. Visitors stay longer and get in touch more often.
whyUsItems.item2: We check in regularly and show progress along the way, so you always know where the project stands.
whyUsItems.item3: We don’t disappear after handover: we make changes, update the site and keep it running smoothly.

ServiceListBlock.title: Services
ServiceListBlock.heading: We handle everything — from design to launch and promotion.

design.title: Design
design.briefText: We plan the structure and design a site that fits your brand.

develop.title: Development
develop.briefText: Sites of any size — from a single page to an online store or web service.

support.title: Promotion & support
support.briefText: We help your site bring in leads and keep it running without issues.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.briefText: We build with modern, reliable tools and integrate AI into your workflows.

AboutUsBlock.headingText: A team that owns the result
AboutUsBlock.text: We’ve been building websites for over <important>six years</important>. We do the design and development ourselves, with no subcontractors, so we own the result — from the first meeting to launch and beyond.

FAQBlock.title: Answers
FAQBlock.headingText: Quick answers about timelines, pricing and how we work.

q1.question: How long does a website take?
q1.answer: It depends on the project. A landing page takes from 1.5 weeks.

q2.question: How much does a website cost?
q2.answer: There are no fixed prices — every project is different. Tell us what you need and we’ll give you a cost and timeline.

q3.question: We have a limited budget. Will you still work with us?
q3.answer: We work with everyone from sole traders to large companies. Tell us your budget and we’ll suggest what’s possible.

q4.question: We’re not based in Moscow. Does that matter?
q4.answer: Not at all. We work across Russia and abroad — by email and Zoom, and in person when we can.

q5.question: What are your payment terms?
q5.answer: 30% upfront, 30% on design sign-off and 40% on build. Terms can be discussed.

q6.question: Can we jump on a call to discuss?
q6.answer: Of course! We’ll set up a Zoom call at a time that suits you.

form.subHeadingText: Fill in the form and we’ll come back with a rough timeline and cost.

tech.title: Technologies
tech.text: We pick the stack to fit the job, not the other way round. Here’s what we use most.

azeez.name: Azeez Abiola
azeez.text: Hi, I’m Azeez — co-founder of Eleven and a full-stack developer. For over 5 years I’ve helped small and large businesses launch websites and services. I write Java and JavaScript and make sure everything runs fast and reliably. I’d be glad to help bring your idea to life.

anna.name: Anna Afanaseva
anna.text: Hi, I’m Anna, co-founder of Eleven. I’ve been creating interfaces for over 5 years: I worked in Sber’s frontend team and built services and landing pages. At Eleven I lead design and frontend — I design sites in Figma and build them myself, so everything looks exactly as intended. I’ll help you create a site people enjoy using.

kasatkin.heading: KASATKIN is an agency that builds web3 products for businesses.
kasatkin.description: We built a landing page that showcases the agency’s work and clearly explains how to work with them. A dark style underlines the tech focus, while clear contact buttons make it easy to get in touch.

ellcakes.heading: Ellcakes is an online store for signature cakes and desserts.
ellcakes.description: We built the store from scratch: catalogue, cart, checkout and personal account, with online payments via YooMoney. Customers pick a cake, pay and track their order in a couple of minutes.

rabotnik.heading: Rabotnik is a recruitment and marketing agency.
rabotnik.description: The site was part of the agency’s rebrand. We explained its services — hiring and marketing — in plain terms and made it easy for both clients and candidates to find what they need and get in touch.

fast-car-sale.heading: Fast Car Sale sells premium cars.
fast-car-sale.description: We built a site that reflects the company’s premium level. Car specs and purchase terms are easy to find, and enquiries take a single click.

ventimax.heading: Ventimax makes livestock equipment.
ventimax.description: The Chinese company was entering the Russian market, and the site became its main showcase. We built a clear catalogue with equipment specs and easy enquiry forms.

perevodik.heading: Perevodchik is a certified document translation agency for foreigners in Russia.
perevodik.description: We built a site that makes it easy to understand how translation and certification work. Services and prices are explained simply, and an enquiry takes a minute.

re-market.heading: ReMarket is a Telegram mini app for buying and selling among Russian speakers abroad.
re-market.description: The goal was to build trust and make buying simple. Listings are easy to post and find, and contacting a seller takes just a couple of taps.

tap.heading: Tap is a Telegram game app with rewards in TON.
tap.description: Together with a partner team we combined games with real rewards. Users complete tasks, earn coins and exchange them for TON, and a clear interface keeps them playing.

medremindr.heading: MedRemindR helps people take their medication on time.
medremindr.description: Many medication apps are too complicated. We made a simple one: reminders arrive on time, doses are easy to log, and profiles let you keep track of the whole family’s medication.
